titre: Recherche et développement des entreprises aux États-Unis
sous_titre: Montants dépensés en 2023, ensemble puis sous-ensembles, en milliards de dollars

Ensemble des entreprises.texte: spending $722 billion on R&D in the United States, a 4.4% increase from 2022

Travaux de développement.texte: $110 billion (15%) was for applied research, and $568 billion (79%) was for development

Industrie manufacturière.texte: In 2023, companies in manufacturing industries performed $394 billion (55%) of domestic R&D

Hors industrie manufacturière.texte: Companies in nonmanufacturing industries performed $328 billion of domestic R&D
